## Ambiguities

Recorded source conflicts and provisional choices; each JSON entry holds its resolution.

| ID | Needs sign-off | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| `a-2022-black-swatch` | yes | Extracted text shows one black swatch as #00000 in the 2022 PDF. |
| `a-2022-rgb-teal-900` | no | The 2022 PDF (p.7, folio 06) lists RGB 4, 65, 64 for #024140, but that hex is 2, 65, 64. |
| `a-2022-rgb-green-700` | no | The 2022 PDF (p.7, folio 06) lists RGB 26, 101, 77 for #19644d, but that hex is 25, 100, 77. |
| `a-2022-print-values-black-white` | no | The 2022 PDF (p.7, folio 06) gives no RGB, CMYK, or PMS values for the black and white swatches; PMS numbers are printed without a C or U suffix. |
| `a-neutrals` | yes | The 2022 PDF lists no neutrals besides black and white, but the themes need grid, rule, axis, and caption grays. eig-brand-guidelines.md named a Warm Gray (#A89F94) and a near-black (#1A1A1A) that appear in neither source guide; the rewritten doc drops both. |
| `a-series-order` | yes | The default series order puts eig_teal_900 next to eig_blue_800 (luminance contrast about 1.4:1), and eig_gold_600, which the previous figure doc used as the second-series and highlight color, has about 2.1:1 contrast on white, below the 3:1 WCAG floor for graphical objects. |
| `a-type-sizes` | yes | The 2022 guide gives no type sizes. The role sizes come from this template (labeled px before token version 2.0.0, but the themes always applied them as points). The 2020 guide specifies smaller sizes. |
| `a-legacy-families-scope` | yes | The 2020 guide specified Galaxie Polaris for charts and tables and Tiempos Text for report body text. For figures and tables the 2022 families supersede them; whether they still govern other EIG materials is not settled. |
